part: days 6–10 (Suzuka by car, Kansai, Itami → New Chitose, Hokkaido car, Rusutsu)

issues.problem: In January 2026 the EV kart ran only in one short midday window (about 11:40–13:20, e.g. Sun Jan 25 11:55–13:05, 80–140 karts a day), so 'about 11:30' will probably not be a bookable time.
issues.fix: On Dec 1 book the slot that the January 2027 schedule shows (probably about 12:00–13:00) and put lunch before or after it; keep the 10:45 arrival.

issues.problem: The note says 'no mountain roads', but the Meihan road climbs to about 500 m between Tenri and Iga and often has snow and ice in late January.
issues.fix: Keep the studless tyres; check road information (JARTIC / NEXCO) in the morning; remove 'no mountain roads' from the notes.

issues.problem: The price for Jan 23–26, 2027 could not be shown (Google Hotels only gives near dates); the hotel has only 12 twin + 7 compact twin rooms.
issues.fix: Book the twin room early (refundable) and check the real price on the official site when booking opens.

issues.problem: City Bus 204 does not go to Kitayama; it goes Kinkakuji-michi → Kitaoji Bus Terminal and loops east.
issues.evidence: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/京都市営バス (route table: 204 北大路BT - 金閣寺道 - 西ノ京円町 - … ; 205 … 北大路BT - 金閣寺道 …)
issues.fix: Bus 204 or 205 Kinkakuji-michi → Kitaoji Bus Terminal (about 15 min), then Karasuma Line Kitaoji → Kitayama (1 stop) and walk 5 min; about 30 min in total.

issues.problem: The official site for Jan 27–30 shows only a smoking twin, ¥12,000 pp on Jan 27–28 and ¥10,500 on Jan 29, so about ¥69,000 for two, not ¥49,500.
issues.fix: Raise the cost to about ¥69,000; accept the smoking twin, book single + extra bed, or choose another Kutchan hotel (e.g. Smart Hotel Kutchan, similar price).

issues.item: CTS car pickup → Hirafu before dark
issues.problem: The drive is about 116 km (1 h 36 without snow); with ski-season queues at the Toyota counter, departure can slip to about 14:00 and arrival near the 16:45 sunset.
issues.fix: Use Toyota self check-in; if you leave CTS after 13:45 take the expressway via Otaru (the plan's backup) or pick up the Rhythm gear next morning.

issues.problem: The 30-min Introduction Course (¥31,000) runs only at 15:00; at 10:00 there is only the 75-min Driving Course (¥61,000) or the ride-alongs.
issues.fix: Book the 10:00 Driving Course (¥61,000; back seat ¥20,000), or move the intro to 15:00 with skiing/lesson in the morning; update the bookFirst entry that says 10:00.

issues.item: Rusutsu drift: prices for Aoki and the pro ride
issues.problem: The Subaru pro ride is ¥17,000 per person (not for two), and Aoki in the back seat costs ¥10,000 (intro) or ¥20,000 (Driving Course); the cost section counts only ¥8,500 each.
issues.fix: Budget ¥34,000 for two pro rides plus the back-seat fee, or drop one; payment is in advance and a 10% cancellation fee starts at booking.

issues.problem: There is no afternoon ticket for 2026–27; the cheapest is the 5-hour ticket at ¥14,500 (¥11,600 online), not about ¥7,000.
issues.fix: Pegasis: budget ¥11,600 (online 5-hour ticket); Aoki as level-1 beginner needs no lift ticket for the first lesson hours.

issues.problem: The afternoon group lesson is 13:30–15:30 (¥8,000), not 13:00–15:00; English groups are not stated; bookings open early October.
issues.fix: Change to 13:30–15:30, leave Rusutsu about 15:45 (Kutchan about 16:30, near sunset); ask by email for an English group.

issues.problem: A coin laundry at Kita 4-jo Higashi 1 could not be confirmed (map sites blocked).
issues.fix: Ask Hotel 3M when booking whether it has a washer, or check Google Maps by hand.
